shots.text: I started testing it in secret.
shots.note: Alone in the dark, only his glint.
Slow motion: a grain falls from the ceiling.

shots.text: I could catch it before it hit the ground.
shots.note: He snatches it out of the air in his jaws.

shots.text: A twig the soldiers needed four ants to cut?
shots.note: Four soldiers strain at a twig.
250 alone: SNAP, the twig flies apart.

shots.text: And when I closed my eyes, I could smell every ant in the tunnels.
shots.note: Hyper senses: every sister glowing through the dirt.

shots.text: Something from outside... and it was getting closer.
